question: How should pre-existing persisted managed active records with no Inventory SKU identity behave after this contract lands?
rationale: The new invariant forbids active state without an identity, but the prior persisted representation cannot supply one; choosing reset, migration, or an alternate compatibility representation is product and upgrade policy.

options.title: Downgrade legacy active records
options.body: On read or migration, convert legacy active records without an identity to setup-required and require a fresh explicit registration.

options.title: Preserve a legacy representation
options.body: Retain a documented legacy active state until a later migration can establish an Inventory identity.

recommendation.title: Downgrade legacy active records
recommendation.body: On read or migration, convert legacy active records without an identity to setup-required and require a fresh explicit registration.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is cited as having approved the new pre-release contract and is best placed to set its upgrade policy.
